tensor_ledger.normalized_qk: 4TaH saved by L2Norm; separate from contiguous/expanded core QK
tensor_ledger.core_qkv: 6TbH for dk=dv and repeated Q/K; saved by FLA
tensor_ledger.A: 2*T*Nv*64 bytes, saved in k dtype; bTH when dv=128
tensor_ledger.gate_beta: O(T*Nv) FP32; small terms omitted from rough envelope
tensor_ledger.norm_gate_out: 6..14*T*bH storage scenarios, not measured confidence bounds
tensor_ledger.chunk_h: BF16 ceil(T/64)*Nv*dk*dv workspace; recreated in backward, not saved in ctx
tensor_ledger.boundary_state: CP initial state and packed count dependence remain separate
tensor_ledger.layer_peak: static + sum(live saved storages) + active-layer workspace; never n*module_peak

limitations: Historical timing uses32K/V-head GDN; current16-head and wider projections are explicit transfers
CP1..8 and historical lengths are reused; no invented measured GDN CP16 cost
FLOPs/time do not uniquely determine saved bytes; implementation/storage lifetime supplies the missing relation
Unfused pre-GDR, no full/GDN/norm recompute; elision scenarios explore local storage uncertainty
Memory scenarios are approximate, not rigorous bounds or runtime permission
Static delta includes major projections/conv only; common MLP/CE follow unmodified source estimate
Attention core Q/KV kept identical between architectures, wide GDN control is not complete Qwen replication
Chunk states/W/U are transient/recomputed; workspace/communication delta not multiplied across layers
Input distributions are constructed mechanisms, no natural prevalence claim
No fixed-vs-dynamic or A-vs-D training advantage established
